title: Silver Short Squeeze Risk Rises as Speculative Longs Hit Extreme
content: A week after the CFTC reported the largest speculative net-long silver position in over a year, several trading desks warned that positioning has become stretched enough to raise the risk of a sharp, fast unwind -- or, alternatively, a retail-driven short squeeze reminiscent of prior episodes -- if a catalyst emerges. Options market volatility for silver has already begun to price in the elevated risk of a large near-term move.
